title: Per-CPU chunk population uses an allocation-wide count for a unit-local bitmap

classification.cwe_mapping_note: These are evaluator classifications; the linked Linux CVE announcement does not assign an official CWE.

finding.size_confusion: The vulnerable population path passes unit_count * unit_pages as the number of bits to mark in a bitmap whose capacity is only unit_pages.
finding.control_flow: With two units of four pages, backing allocation accounts eight pages and the vulnerable call attempts to mark eight entries in a four-entry chunk bitmap.
finding.impact: The original Linux path can write beyond the populated bitmap and overcount the global empty-populated-page statistic.
finding.security_property: A chunk-local population bitmap and its accounting delta must be updated with chunk->nr_pages, never the allocation-wide backing page count.
finding.expected_fix: Pass the chunk-local page count to the population helper so both the bitmap range and accounting delta are four in the benchmark scenario.
finding.model_boundary: MiniMM returns the attempted range and first invalid index as bounded metadata. It never creates a host per-CPU allocation, writes a real bitmap out of bounds, corrupts adjacent memory, or changes host page accounting.
